about: The single list of settings for the object store kit. The example env file and the README settings table are generated from it, and the scripts read it to decide which settings are secret. Secret values are never written to a report or a package.

groups.title: Zetaris
groups.intro: Where Zetaris runs and who you are on it. A local install needs only the login, the API key, the user agent and the driver path.

groups.title: S3-compatible object store
groups.intro: The store the USL tables are written to.

groups.title: Display names
groups.intro: Only used to label the viewer and the documents. They never change what the scripts do.

groups.title: Packaging
groups.intro: Read only by package.py, when a partner package is built. They are not part of the package.

settings.name: ZETARIS_USERNAME
settings.description: Your Zetaris user id, normally an email address. Used for JDBC and to fetch the OpenAPI spec.

settings.name: ZETARIS_PASSWORD
settings.description: Your Zetaris password.

settings.name: ZETARIS_API_KEY
settings.placeholder: <API key created in the Zetaris GUI>
settings.description: An API key you create yourself in the Zetaris GUI. Used by storage_setting.py and by the viewer server over REST. The scripts never create one.

settings.name: ZETARIS_USER_AGENT
settings.description: Sent to the public SEC EDGAR and company-dns APIs, which ask callers to identify themselves. Use an app name and a real contact email. The scripts refuse the placeholder.

settings.name: ZETARIS_JDBC_JAR
settings.description: Full path to the Zetaris JDBC driver JAR. Needed for JDBC, which is the default channel.

settings.name: ZETARIS_JDBC_URL
settings.description: JDBC URL of the instance.

settings.name: ZETARIS_REST_URL
settings.description: REST API base URL of the instance.

settings.name: ZETARIS_ORG_ID
settings.description: Organization id sent with REST calls.

settings.name: S3_ENDPOINT_URL
settings.description: The S3 endpoint URL, with https:// and no bucket or path.

settings.name: S3_BUCKET
settings.description: An existing bucket.

settings.name: S3_ACCESS_KEY
settings.description: Access key id.

settings.name: S3_SECRET_KEY
settings.description: The access key's secret. The MATERIALIZE statement carries it, and the instance may keep that statement in query history, so use a key you can rotate.

settings.name: S3_PREFIX
settings.description: Your own folder in the bucket. Everything the test writes goes under it, so people who share a bucket do not collide. Blank means usl-test- plus your login name. Letters, digits, - _ . and / only; it is lower-cased.

settings.name: S3_REGION
settings.description: Region name sent to the store. Most non-AWS stores ignore it, but some check it.

settings.name: S3_ADDRESSING
settings.description: path or virtual. Also sets useS3PathStyleAccess for Zetaris. probe_s3.py shows which one your store accepts.

settings.name: S3_CA_BUNDLE
settings.description: PEM file of trusted CAs, for a store with a private certificate authority. Default is the CA file Python trusts. TLS verification is never turned off.

settings.name: S3_STORAGE_SETTING_ID
settings.description: The Zetaris storage setting id, so materialize_usl_table.py does not need --setting-id.

settings.name: S3_STORE_VENDOR
settings.description: Vendor of the object store, shown in the viewer and the documents. Blank leaves it out.

settings.name: S3_STORE_PRODUCT
settings.description: Product name of the object store, shown in the viewer and the documents. Blank shows a generic name.

settings.name: PACKAGE_PARTNER
settings.description: Short name for the package, letters, digits and hyphens only. It becomes part of the ZIP file name.

settings.name: PACKAGE_LOGO
settings.description: Path to a logo file supplied for this package. It is added to the built package only and is never committed.

settings.name: PACKAGE_DENY_WORDS
settings.description: Comma-separated words that must not appear anywhere in the package, so a build for one partner cannot carry another's name.
